core_obligations: Unwind flatness of the morphism of ringed sites in terms of the module O_X over the inverse image of O_Y (proof lines 6234-6235).
Reduce that flatness to a stalk condition using the exactness of the stalk functor (proof lines 6236-6239).
Compare with the stalk criterion for flatness of the morphism of spaces and conclude (proof lines 6240-6241).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is flat if and only if the associated morphism of ringed sites (f_small, f^sharp) : (X_etale, O_X) -> (Y_etale, O_Y) is flat (source lines 6219-6231). The proof unwinds the definition of flatness of a morphism of ringed sites as flatness of O_X as a module over the inverse image of O_Y, notes that this can be checked at stalks by the exactness of the stalk functor, and compares with the already established criterion that flatness of f can be checked at stalks.
